# Exploring and wrangling data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

### Viewing the 3 data sets

```{r}
View(mutations)
View(patients)
View(samples)
```

### Combining the 3 data sets

```{r}
combined_data <- mutations |> 
  left_join(samples,
            by = c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode" = "SAMPLE_ID")) |> 
  left_join(patients,
            by = c("PATIENT_ID"))
```

### Selecting interesting columns from the 3 data sets

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data |> 
  select(AGE_GROUP,
         AGE_AT_SEQ_REPORT,
         SEX,
         OS_STATUS,
         CANCER_TYPE,
         PRIMARY_SITE,
         SAMPLE_TYPE,
         DRUG_TYPE,
         Chromosome,
         Start_Position,
         End_Position,
         Protein_position,
         Variant_Classification
         )

View(combined_data)
```

### Exploring plots

```{r}
ggplot(data = combined_data,
       aes(x = CANCER_TYPE,
           fill = SEX)) +
    geom_bar()
```
